  • Class
    Description
    IntrospectEveryClassVisitor
    Marks every class of the package "introspectall", and every class whose name starts with "IntrospectAll" for the Python compiler, which chooses the package of its classes, @Introspected(hierarchy = true) ahead of the introspection visitor, as the TCK harness of micronaut-validation did with every class it compiled, and writes the source of Later extends Seed<String> when it visits Seed, so that a later round holds both the classes written so far and a new class of the application.
    RecordingTypeHierarchyVisitor
    Records the hierarchies that TypeHierarchyImport asks for a second time, through VisitorContext.tryRecordTypeHierarchy(ClassElement, io.micronaut.inject.ast.Element...), and keeps what the API returned by the name of the record, for a test to compare with the record it loads.
    TypeHierarchyFuzz
    Generates random generic hierarchies in Java, Kotlin or Python source, and checks the TypeHierarchy the compiler recorded for each against the hierarchy java.lang.reflect reads from the compiled class: the closure of the declaration, of a raw parameterization and of a concrete one.
    TypeHierarchyFuzz.Arr
    An array.
    TypeHierarchyFuzz.Cls
    A class without arguments: String, Integer, Number.
    TypeHierarchyFuzz.Concrete
    A concrete type argument.
    TypeHierarchyFuzz.Generated
    A generated class.
    TypeHierarchyFuzz.Generator
    Generates random classes.
    TypeHierarchyFuzz.Language
    The language the declarations are rendered in.
    TypeHierarchyFuzz.Oracle
    The reflective closure, walked the way the compiler lists it: the type, the super class and its super types, then each interface and its super types, each rendering once, Object last.
    TypeHierarchyFuzz.Param
    A parameterized class: List, Map, Optional.
    TypeHierarchyFuzz.SuperType
    A super class or interface with its arguments; a raw one has none while its declaration has variables.
    TypeHierarchyFuzz.TypeExpr
    A type expression.
    TypeHierarchyFuzz.Var
    A type variable of the class.
    TypeHierarchyFuzz.Variable
    A type variable declaration with its bounds, several for an intersection.
    TypeHierarchyFuzz.Wild
    A wildcard: unbounded, upper bounded or lower bounded.
    TypeStrings
    Prints arguments the way a declaration reads, for the assertions of the type hierarchy specs.
